via.quote: Backtrack to the junction with Mangorei Track and head downhill to Pouākai Hut

evidence: You can walk the track in either direction, but there is less climbing if you walk from the North Taranaki Visitor Centre to Mangorei Road.
The Pouākai Crossing begins on the Veronica Loop Track, starting at North Egmont.
Pouākai Hut to Mangorei Road end
The long descent to the road end winds through cool forest dripping with mosses and lichens
This is a one-way track so you need to arrange transport to and from one end.

not_on_route.name: Mangorei Track to Pouākai tarns day walk

doubts: No road end feature at North Egmont, so the start is given as the North Egmont place (T13), which the text names as the start alongside the North Taranaki Visitor Centre. The page says the walk can be done in either direction; recorded as described (Visitor Centre to Mangorei Road). The tarns are on the described way (out and back from the Mangorei Track junction); the page also suggests skipping them and going straight to Pouākai Hut if tired, not recorded as a separate way. Time and distance are DOC's summary; the text says 'a 19km track' taking '7 hr 30 mins and 9 hr 30 mins'. Pouākai Trig ref T15 (peak Pouākai) assumed to be the trig the text names.
